Sandbox_COOP_BooksAtHome_tooltip: The shared checklist of skill books, recipe magazines and educational VHS tapes.
Sandbox_COOP_MapShare_tooltip: The MP tick box on the world map that shares every symbol and note you draw.
Sandbox_COOP_ItemOutput_tooltip: The picker that sends crafted items and removed vehicle parts to your bags, a nearby container or the ground.
Sandbox_COOP_Organization_tooltip: The custom perk that replaces the Organized and Disorganized traits. Turning it off leaves containers that were already enlarged at their current size.
Sandbox_COOP_Pings_tooltip: Marking a spot for everyone with the Ping key, on the world map or in the world.
Sandbox_COOP_Todo_tooltip: The list everyone on the server can add to and tick off.
Sandbox_COOP_HotbarStatus_tooltip: Colours the background of a hotbar slot by how worn the item is - one column per status it has. Purely local, it only draws.
Sandbox_COOP_PingDuration_tooltip: How long a ping stays on screen and on the map.
Sandbox_COOP_PingCooldown_tooltip: The shortest gap between two pings from the same player. Raise it if anyone is spamming.
Sandbox_COOP_PingChatLine_tooltip: Writes a line in chat for every ping, so you notice one placed while you were looking elsewhere.
Sandbox_COOP_OrganizationXpRate_tooltip: Multiplies the experience gained for moving weight through containers. 1 is the default pace.
Sandbox_COOP_TodoMaxEntries_tooltip: How many lines the shared list will hold before it refuses new ones.
